name: Okta
description: Okta is an identity security platform that the vendor says "secures all types of identity from AI agents to your customers, employees, and partners," providing workforce identity and access management.
best_for: Positioned for enterprises, governments, and public sector agencies across industries (financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, travel, technology, energy), as well as small businesses and developers.
features: Single Sign-On (SSO) across a large integration network
Identity governance and identity security posture management

alternatives.name: Auth0
alternatives.description: An Okta product offering a developer-focused authentication and authorization platform with 30+ SDKs.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and B2B/B2C SaaS companies embedding customer identity into their own apps.

alternatives.name: Cloudflare
alternatives.description: Provides network and application security services including WAF, bot management, and DDoS mitigation.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations of all sizes wanting perimeter/application-layer security alongside identity.
